header.description: Version 2.0 aero model for HL-20 lifting body, as described in TM-107580 [01]. Original data built from wind tunnel test data described in [00]. This aero model was used for HL-20 approach and landing studies at NASA Langley Research Center during 1989-1995 and for a follow-on study at NASA Johnson Space Center in 1994 and NASA Ames Research Center in 2001. This DAVE-ML implementation created 2003 by Bruce Jackson to demonstrate DAVE-ML.

modification_records.description: Revision 1.24: Fixed typo in CLRUD0 function description which gave dependent signal name as "CLRUD1." Bill Cleveland of NASA Ames caught this in his xml2ftp script. Also made use of 1.5b2 fileHeader fields and changed date formats to comply with convention.
Revision 178: added date to modificationRecord A; renamed all docID attributes in each documentRef to 'refID'; this to update to DTD 1.9.
Revision 217: Added variable (with Mach) limits to angle-of-attack to match LaSRS++ and Ref 01; replaced all (now deprecated) xns attributes with email address information.
Revision 218: Added variable ALPR which Missy pointed out are needed by the checkcases.

Revision 221: Updated to DAVE-ML 2.0: replaced signalID elements with varID elements in checkcase data; replaced fileCreationDate and functionCreationDate with creationDate elements; corrected names and units to new AIAA naming convention.
Revision 234: Removed ALPR variable references since they're not used. Changed variable names to match new S-119 convention; changed units to match new S-119 convention.
Added xmlns attribute to DAVEfunc to conform to DTD 2, RC3.
Added ref 0, the original wind tunnel compendium used to develop this aero model
Added isInput to input variables, taking advantage of this optional attribute of DAVE-ML 2

Rewrote ALP variableDef to more properly use the &piecewise& MathML function. It was previously structured as an embedded piecewise function inside an outer one to avoid a limitation of LaRC's DAVEtool parser. This poor structure was pointed out by Greg McCarthy at DFRC.

Added namespace to <math> elements, xmlns attribute to DAVEfunc, and gtIDs to conform to DTD 2.0; renamed function and functionDefn identifiers so function names will be distinct from the associated dependentVariable varID to reduce confusion.
